_**Agent (grok-4.7)**_

Restart the dev server. You do not need a rebuild.

Next.js reads `.env` once when the process starts. Keys such as `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `TATUM_API_KEY`, and `MEMWAL_PRIVATE_KEY` are server-only, so they are not baked into the frontend bundle. After you save `.env`:

1. Stop `npm run dev` (Ctrl+C).
2. Start it again with `npm run dev`.

A browser refresh alone keeps the old key. One-off commands such as `npm run health` pick up the new value on the next run, because each run starts a fresh process.
